description: This file defines the AdminAccessDeniedHandler class which implements Spring Security's AccessDeniedHandler interface to handle access denied situations by redirecting users to a specified URL.

classes.name: AdminAccessDeniedHandler
classes.description: A class that handles access denied exceptions by redirecting to a configurable URL.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles access denied exceptions by redirecting the response to a configured URL.

methods.name: getAccessDeniedUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect to when access is denied.

methods.name: setAccessDeniedUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL to redirect to when access is denied.
